text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Starting canary rollout: service=ingest-api region=eu-green weight=10% (deploy/2026.03.17_21)
incident-bot: Alert: spike in TLS handshake failures downstream. metric=client_tls_5xx rate=22% region=apac host=ingest.redwood.example.com
sally_oncall: paging in pagerduty, looking now. any proven customer impact? :phone:
ajay_be: seeing a lot of 495/526 from edge in apac. stack shows TLS alert during handshake, SNI mismatch in logs. this is odd, deploy targeted EU only.
maria_infra: I can confirm route-weights propagated oddly. our geo-router received updated service weights that included apac -> eu-green for a subset of POPs. might be a propagation bug in the rollout controller.
kevin_sre: summary: eu canary flipped new cert config in green, but certs not yet provisioned in apac edge for that green; some apac clients got routed to eu-green and hit handshake failure. customer-facing 5xx as TLS.
support: 3 customers on the feed tier reported outages (Zendesk refs #5421 #5423). support triage says errors started ~21:03 UTC.
sally_oncall: agree we should kill the rollout flag and shift traffic back to blue. can someone flip the canary flag quickly? if not, rollback entire deploy.
ajay_be: I can flip the flag. route-controller flag path: `feature.rollout.ingest-api.green_enabled` -> false
ajay_be: running:
```bash
# disable canary in feature service
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://control-plane.internal/api/flags/ingest-api -d '{"green_enabled":false}'
``` 
maria_infra: also disabling routing weight assignment to eu-green from the orchestrator now:
```bash
kubectl -n routing set image job/geo-weight-sync pause=true || true
# OR call internal API
POST /internal/orchestrator/weights {"service":"ingest-api","region":"eu","weight":0}
```
incident-bot: action recorded: flag flip by ajay_be @3798881278
kevin_sre: observing edge telemetry — TLS errors dropping. client_tls_5xx rate down to 3% in apac within 40s. :white_check_mark:
support: confirming with customers, one of the three says errors cleared for them.
sally_oncall: good. recording mitigation steps. we should still rollback the deploy artifact and not re-run the cert provisioning until we ensure routing isolation.
ajay_be: initiating rollback of deploy/2026.03.17_21 -> rolling back to deploy/2026.03.16_12
```bash
deployctl rollback --service ingest-api --to deploy/2026.03.16_12 --region eu
``` 
deploy-bot: Rollback job submitted (job id: rb-38912). ETA ~2m
maria_infra: I pushed a temporary egress ACL to prevent apac edge from picking up eu-green route advertisements while we validate certs.
kevin_sre: monitoring metrics: global 5xx back to baseline. latency stable. No further customer pages so far.
product-ops: note for postmortem: the rollout controller propagated weight changes cross-region during a partial flag flip. Also the cert automation assumed local provisioning and didn't gate by region advertise.
sally_oncall: handoff: I'm staying on for 20m to confirm stability, then handing to kevin for the rest of the night. please start a postmortem ticket and add timeline + customer impact notes.
kevin_sre: ack, I will monitor and pick up at +20m. starting a watch: `monitoring watch ingest-api --window 15m --alerts tls-handshake` and I'll put a short status in #incidents every 10.
incident-bot: Page closed by sally_oncall @3798881409
support: we notified impacted customers with interim note: "We've mitigated an issue causing intermittent TLS errors to some APAC clients. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a detailed update." - sent 21:08 UTC
ajay_be: logging for postmortem:
- root cause: rollout controller propagated route weights beyond targeted region when feature flag changed.
- contributing: cert provisioning job is region-scoped; no cross-region cert available for green in APAC.
- mitigation: immediate flag kill and rollback, egress ACL, stop rollout controller job.
- followups: add gating in rollout controller to ensure region-bound weight changes; add test for cert provisioning before weight advertise; customer incident report.
product-ops: estimated impacted requests ~ 12k over 5m window, 3 customers reported errors. tagging SLO/alerts owners.
sally_oncall: adding to calendar: postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC, owners: ajay_be, maria_infra, kevin_sre, product-ops, support.
kevin_sre: handing off monitoring to night team after 20m. will create a short alert suppression for non-actionable noise on client_tls_5xx during the investigation window.
support: keep me posted for customer followup copy. also want timeseries export for affected customers.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 3798881409 — status: recovered. Followups required: postmortem, rollout controller patch, cert-provisioning check.
kevin_sre: closing note: service stable at 21:11 UTC. will file final incident summary in ops-incident-tracker and attach logs.
product-ops: thanks everyone. good coordination. we'll schedule the RCA and include a checklist to avoid cross-region advertise during partial canaries."
